name: techvortex-iiitg
description: TechVortex IIITG — Climate and Ocean Intelligence Platform

scripts.frontend: concurrently -n "HUB,SURFSAFE,OCEANGUARD,OCEANIQ" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold,white.bold" "cd weather-module/frontend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && set BROWSER=none&& npm start" "cd OceanGuard/frontend && npm run dev" "cd \"learning hub/ocean-iq\" && npm run dev"
scripts.backend: concurrently -n "HUB-API,OG-API,WX-API,CHATBOT" -c "magenta.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8001" "cd OceanGuard/backend && .\\venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --port 8002" "cd weather-module/backend/api && python -m uvicorn forecast_api:app --port 8000" "cd chatbot && python app.py"
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "Get-Process python, node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'All TechVortex services stopped.'"
